desc: A Medieval copper alloy mount, enamelled in the Limoges tradition and probably dating from about the 12th to 13th centuries AD. The mount is sub circular in shape. title: File:Dish decorated with a scene from the Nō play 'Momijigari' ('Maple Viewing') - RC110.tif
desc: Large, slightly lobed iron dish by Komai of Kyoto decorated with a scene from the Nō play Momijigari. Signed on the reverse "Dai Nippon Kyoto Ju Komai Sei" - "Made by Komai, resident of Kyoto, Great Japan". The iron dish is ornately decorated with gold, silver, copper, shibuichi and shakudo inlays.
